acceptanceCriteria: Reject any non-whitespace trailing bytes after a release smoke JSON receipt, including a malformed second JSON value; retain acceptance of exactly one valid JSON value with optional trailing whitespace.

Add regression controls using otherwise-valid supported documentation search receipts plus malformed trailing bytes, valid second JSON values, and whitespace; preserve supported schema, exact operation, and nonempty-result validation.
Retain reproduction and independent review with focused release smoke qualification; do not broaden PR418 extra repair scope or imply archive/platform qualification from parser controls.
body: Inherited confirmed parser gap found during approved PR418 extra repair review, outside the changed receipt-profile predicate. internal/companionrelease/core_smoke.go decodeClosedJSON (integration baseline 0b8fe85c65d326784bb85d619ede55a1a0356c3f, published predecessor d99b49cf60ca570a36f18346d3a0fc11fff44e94) returns an error only when the second decoder.Decode succeeds; any error, including malformed trailing data, is treated as EOF. Reproduction: validateDocumentationCorpusSearch on {"schema":"corvint-corpus-receipt/2","operation":"search","results":[{}]} followed by an incomplete { passes its current decodeClosedJSON boundary; the second Decode returns syntax/EOF error and the helper returns nil, so the subsequent profile/search/results predicates all pass. Expected only io.EOF after exactly one value; actual malformed trailing bytes accepted. Existing new control with a complete second {} is correctly refused and does not cover this inherited case. Installed Core build163 / Tasks build202; review source is same public-lineage repository. Independent source evidence /tmp/corvint-parallel-dispatch/corpus91-independent-review.json. Dedup searches trailing, decodeClosedJSON, malformed trailing, closed JSON found no equivalent; V1-0575 trailing result is a separate CEM/Tasks prototype. This filing is not authorization to expand the single approved additional repair cycle.
title: Release smoke JSON decoder accepts malformed trailing bytes
